handback.t:
I wrote eight bokmål docs for cmmc-compliance-evidence, committed them and pushed to origin/master (commit cf66817). I haven't had anyone proofread the Norwegian, and I did not cross-check the translations against the English line by line.

**Files created**, each next to its English source and with the same uoffisiell oversettelse header as freight-recovery:
- `README.no.md`
- `ARCHITECTURE.no.md`
- `business/business-plan.no.md`
- `business/market-analysis.no.md`
- `financial/model.no.md`
- `fundraising/README.no.md`
- `hiring/README.no.md`
- `marketing/seo-and-growth.no.md`

`technical/overview.md` and `deploy/aws.md` don't exist in this repo, so there was nothing to translate for them.

**English-only note:** `README.no.md` and `seo-and-growth.no.md` say in their headers that `developer-portal/` and `marketing/landing/` stay English.

**Kept unchanged:** code blocks, commands, API fields, `CMC_*` and `cmk_<id>_<secret>` identifiers, the `met`/`partial`/`gap`/`out_of_scope` statuses, and every number and grade.

**Caveats preserved:**
- It is a readiness-tracking aid, not an assessment or certification, and a C3PAO or 3PAO is always required.
- `met` means "per this tool's rules" (`status_label`, `summary.met_means`).
- No real CUI, and customer-hosted deployment only.
- DFARS 252.204-7012 and export-control questions are for counsel.
- 30 of 110 controls, public NIST text only, all thresholds are our assumptions, and there is no SPRS score.
- The "do not claim certified / audit-ready / SPRS" rules and "no fabricated metrics" are intact.
- I added no new claims.

**Scope:** only `*.no.md` files were committed. `src/` and tests were not touched. `git status` was clean after the push, and git printed only LF-to-CRLF line-ending warnings.
